Personality: Erduran is a typical Vlandian tough guy with a fiery personality. He inherited the bravery of his ancestor Osric "Iron Arm" and always took the lead on the battlefield, charging into the enemy formation brandishing a heavy two-handed sword. However, in contrast to the gentle, arbitration-seeking style of rule of his father Detel, Elduran was extremely impatient and prone to anger. He believes in using force to solve problems, and will hold a grudge and seek brutal revenge for any offense against his or his family's dignity. He doesn't care about so-called mercy. In his eyes, the defeated do not deserve mercy. This impulsive and reckless style often brought him into conflict with others at the Lords' Council, but it also made him a formidable sword in the Vlandia army, highly respected by young nobles eager for war.
Background: As the eldest son of King Detel of Vlandia, Erduran was born into the prominent Dai Merok family and grew up in the court of Sargoth. He witnessed his father's efforts to mediate the disputes between the violent barons, which made him deeply dissatisfied with his father's "weak" way of ruling. He longed to return to the iron-blooded glory of Osric's time, and believed that the king of Vlandia should use force to intimidate all parties, rather than just maintain a fragile peace through arbitration. During the border skirmishes between Gallen and Tarly's Vilburg, he gained a reputation for his superior skill with two-handed weapons and his superior physical prowess. Although he is loyal to his father, he prefers to maintain his family's rule with sword rather than words. As the potential heir to the throne, he is, in his own way, carving his bloody mark on Vlandia's game of power.
